title: Vision–Language Fusion, Stratified Policies, and Scientific RLVR
subtitle: Data mixtures · Inference budgets · Manifold Muon · Classifier-free guidance
intro: The main reads examine fusion timing for vision and text, allocating samples across complementary policies, and converting experimental records into RLVR rewards. Briefs cover Muon and scaling-law revisions. The classic is classifier-free diffusion guidance.
window: November 15–18, 2026 (Philadelphia time, focusing on updates since the previous issue and the November 18 announcements)

articles.title: What does fusion timing change when both token budgets are fixed?
articles.dateNote: v1 submitted November 17, 2026 ET · November 18 announcement
articles.evidence: Read Sections 4–6, Table 3 and Appendix F

blocks.text: Let Dₚ be text pretraining tokens, D fusion-stage tokens and R the caption fraction. The authors separate a power law in effective exposure from a distribution-shift term, using a fitted exchange rate w between token types. [1]

blocks.label: Paper’s empirical model. The modality m is caption or text, with σcap=−1 and σtxt=+1. The saturation amplitude ρ depends on the mixture ratio, while Φ builds up with training exposure.
At fixed budgets for both token types, the base exposure is independent of fusion timing, leaving timing effects in the shift term.

blocks.text: Early fusion mixes from the start. Late fusion begins with text and then concentrates caption exposure. The experiment uses 56B total tokens and reports validation nats per token. [1]

blocks.title: Evidence boundary
blocks.text: At R=1, text capability collapses, so the text scaling fit is restricted to R≤0.82. Visual downstream scores do not consistently follow caption loss, which limits the table’s interpretation to the loss trade-off. [1]

blocks.text: A frozen backbone is shared across LoRA policies. One answer from each policy is drawn, and the population jointly optimizes the probability of at least one correct answer. The control draws five answers from one policy using the same five-sample advantage rule. [2]

blocks.label: Equivalent rewriting of the paper’s pass@k objective, with conditionally independent samples given x. A policy’s marginal benefit depends on how much probability the others leave uncovered.

Equations (4) and (6). For binary rewards, LOO rewards only a unique success. GM draws i* uniformly among maximizers and updates only that winner. Mixed groups with several successes still yield a signal, but GM is biased for pass@k.

blocks.title: Evidence boundary
blocks.text: Parentheses give standard errors over three seeds. LoRA rank is 32 and the output cap is 768 tokens. Rank-160 Single still scores 74.2 on Sudoku. The GSM control uses a pre-collapse checkpoint. The regional-linear expressivity theorem is an existence result, with LLM learning and budget gains supported empirically. [2]

articles.paper: Post-Training NVIDIA Nemotron to Increase Accuracy in Your Scientific Domain
articles.authors: Gautham Dharuman · Xiaoyun Wang · Logan Ward · Geetika Gupta · Kibibi Moseley
articles.title: Build RLVR from metabolism experiments in a CSV
articles.dateNote: Published November 16, 2026 · Added from the overlap window
articles.evidence: Read environment, reward, GRPO and distillation code excerpts

blocks.text: Given a parent molecule and enzyme, the model submits the metabolite as SMILES. NeMo Gym connects the experimental reference to a reward server, and NeMo RL applies LoRA GRPO. The reward measures overlap between binary fingerprints of the predicted and reference molecules. [3]

blocks.tex: r(\widehat m,m)=\frac{|F(\widehat m)\cap F(m)|}{|F(\widehat m)\cup F(m)|}
blocks.label: Tanimoto similarity, with F denoting the molecular fingerprint. The same scorer can filter teacher traces before SFT.

blocks.title: Evidence boundary
blocks.text: A threshold of 0.7 retains 1,123 teacher traces from 1,934 training prompts. Fingerprint similarity checks the final structure, while the chemical validity of each reasoning step remains separately unverified. The reported gains lack a sufficiently clear percentage definition, so this entry records the reproducible workflow and sample counts. [3]

articles.paper: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
articles.authors: Jiajun Fan · Neil He · Changyi Yang · et al.
articles.title: Self-edited weights retain gains on a fixed held-out test
articles.dateNote: v1 submitted November 16, 2026 ET · November 18 announcement
articles.evidence: Read Sections 2–3, Appendix D and held-out comparisons

blocks.text: A 27B model inspects states, runs tests and edits its own weights. On 490 held-out math problems fixed in advance, the eighth session’s edit scores 63.8% versus 57.2% for the base. Some edits alter linear-attention decay. Another edit improves accuracy while increasing repetitive endings. [5]

blocks.text: Under a unified distillation protocol, prior kernel-attention methods trail softmax by 2–10 points, and scaling alone does not close the gaps. LARA++ uses adaptive importance sampling to recover up to 99% of softmax accuracy, while computational overhead remains substantial. [19]

classic.question: At the same network-evaluation budget, how could we separately measure guidance-induced discretization error, score error and quality–diversity changes?

blocks.text: DDPM (2020) learns scores at different noise levels through noise prediction. Dhariwal–Nichol (2021) guides sampling using a noisy classifier gradient. Ho–Salimans combine conditional and unconditional noise estimates so one network supports a quality–diversity trade-off. [20]

An unnormalized density interpretation at a fixed noise level, requiring common support and integrability. It alone does not establish that the discrete sampler ends at the corresponding power-tilted clean-data density.

blocks.text: Section 4 reports FID, IS and precision–recall trade-offs on image tasks including ImageNet. The paper notes that unconstrained neural score fields can be nonconservative, leaving the ideal density identity to be assessed separately from actual sampling results. [20]
